method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: Uniform dark-grey field bleeding off both edges, the eight tiny, label outside the safe zone.
notes.fix: Pull the field inside the frame with a lit border, darker, raking key; label inside the margin.

notes.problem: Even mid-grey waffle, no pool; label outside the safe zone at x 23.
notes.fix: Low raking three quarter, one pool on the eight, field to black at the edges, label inside the margin.

notes.problem: Even mid grey field; label 23 px from the edge.
notes.fix: Side light falling to near black; label inside the margin.

notes.problem: Straight-on plan reads as a keyboard; carrier tight under the dek.
notes.fix: Tilt off plan 15 to 20 degrees; drop the carrier 60 px.

notes.problem: Straight-on plan reads as a chart; carrier 25 px under the dek; lightest ground.
notes.fix: Raking three quarter, lowered 120 px, darker ground.

notes.problem: Straight-on plate under the dek reads as a chart.
notes.fix: Low three quarter view under a raking key; plate pushed down.

notes.problem: Even dark-grey tail fields; neck reads as two caps with a gap.
notes.fix: Continuous hourglass neck; low key so the rim and bundles carry the highlight.

notes.problem: The neck reads as two bead bands with a gap and four springs.
notes.fix: A continuous bridge of tails in a second material, warm side key, centred.

notes.problem: Bare wireframe racks on a mid-grey pool.
notes.fix: Crop in on the half filled tower with lit chamfers; tight pool.

notes.problem: Tube racks primitive; pool on empty floor, subject in half shade.
notes.fix: Centre the pool on the tower and the sliding tray; darken the open floor.

notes.problem: Small tower in empty floor, near twin of 9; pulled tray small.
notes.fix: High three quarter close on the pulled tray.

notes.problem: One rack in a mostly empty frame says nothing about tuning.
notes.fix: Push in; pull one tray half out with a cable to it.

notes.problem: Two lowest cyan bars duller teal.
notes.fix: One emissive value on all eight bars.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored
shortfall: at the round cap the finished deck ships at 6.97, 1.03 under the 8.0 top rung. Name that in the email and the run record
craft_note: at the round cap the craft floor stands down. The art median 6.8 is under 8.5 and the deck ships as it is. Name it in the run record
